name: source_timestamp
description: Timestamp supplied by the decoded telemetry payload, or safe fallback for malformed input.

name: ingested_at
description: Timestamp at which telemetry-edge accepted the record.

name: processed_at
description: Timestamp at which telemetry-processor handled this delivery.

name: vehicle_id
description: Always null until trusted ownership is resolved.

name: vin
description: VIN when present; never used to guess ownership.

name: tesla_vehicle_id
description: Always null when ownership is unresolved.

name: telemetry_config_version
description: Configuration version when trusted metadata is available.

name: telemetry_config_hash
description: Configuration hash when trusted metadata is available.

name: pubsub_delivery_attempt
description: Approximate Pub/Sub delivery attempt when supplied.

name: telemetry_receiver_version
description: Pinned Tesla Fleet Telemetry receiver version.

name: receiver_record_version
description: Receiver transport record version when supplied.

name: quarantine_reason
description: Reason trusted ownership routing could not complete.
